scope: Independent read-only material/source review of FA entry points and runtime README; no FA ELF execution, no model/operator build, no numerical validation. Frozen payload not edited.

observations.finding: Empty manifest cases list vacuously satisfies len(rows)==len(cases) and all(...), reporting pass without execution. Entry reads manifest before verifying either payload and creates outdir immediately.
observations.impact: Shipped manifest has cases, so valid four-case path unaffected; malformed/modified manifest acceptance path is insufficiently guarded. Do not treat wrapper as independently proving exactly four cases.
observations.recommendation: Verify payload data and require exact four expected case IDs/nonempty list before creating output; new immutable revision or explicit unqualified capability.

observations.finding: Outdir is not rejected when nested inside operator/runtime payload; mkdir runs before replay verifier, leaving payload polluted when child rejects unexpected files.
observations.impact: Fails rather than false-positive under valid manifest, but irreversible directory pollution breaks later verification until removed.
observations.recommendation: Reject nested payload output before mkdir.

observations.finding: No whole-payload verify.py --data-only call before execution; patch/postimages are checked but other executable/config hooks are not preverified here. Build inherits entire host environment, including CPATH/CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH/LD/PYTHON/CMake-related variables.
observations.impact: Model-source build is explicitly not executed/accepted this revision; README correctly requires new runtime qualification. Future rebuild is not a hermetic qualified operation merely because GCC version gate passes.
observations.recommendation: Keep model_build not_checked and environment limitations explicit, or add immutable-revision preflight and allowlist/build-tool identities before accepting builds.

observations.finding: Build subprocesses use an environment subset but PATH/LANG values are inherited; top-level verify.py runs in unsanitized environment. Top-level toolchain/system dependencies are not wholly hermetic.
observations.impact: Exact clang/lld/objdump binaries and shipped header hashes are checked; no numerical or timing acceptance inferred by build_result. Scope is appropriately build-only.
observations.recommendation: For a future accepted standalone build capability, sanitize before verifier and use fixed PATH/locale; qualify rebuilt ELF separately as documented.

positive_findings: replay validates both payloads and rejects all internal symlinks; default replay checks fixed runtime/ELF/conf hashes
replay environment is explicit allowlist with output-local TMPDIR; outdir outside operator/model, preflight explicitly does not execute ELF
qualification overrides require explicit mode; PASS requires simulator rc0, expected cycles, three artifacts and exact uncompressed full trace identity
operator build pins compiler/linker/objdump and shipped API/harness/sysroot header digests and labels build-only
model restore uses patch -p1 with postimage checks and -j4; GCC/libstdc++ gate and qualification required
README explicitly retains model-build not performed, zero-input timing-only, numerical unresolved and no mainline same-ELF inference
review_level: material_checked for source/claim consistency only; qualified_run/build/numerical not_checked
overall: Limited material review with findings; not full NDF conformance PASS. Parent informed; fixes require new revision or explicit capability limitation; do not silently mutate uploaded payload.

followup.method: Read-only independent review of new script bytes and author three negative-test records; no independent FA execution/build
resolved_by_code_review: FA-R1 empty cases now require exactly four fixed IDs and length4 before output creation; data integrity verifiers run before mkdir
FA-R2 nested payload output rejected before mkdir
FA-R3 whole runtime verify --data-only added before recovery; C compiler GCC gate added alongside C++ libstdc++ gate; actual configure/build use explicit env allowlist
followup.author_tests_reviewed: All three author negative tests rc2 and output_created=false; this is evidence review, not reattributed execution
remaining_limits: verify subprocesses, git archive/patch and compiler macro/version checks in rebuild still run with inherited host env before sanitized build; selected compiler resolved with inherited PATH. Do not call whole recovery/build operation hermetic. Actual cmake compile environment now cleared.
qualify preflight verifier environment inherited; child replay itself sanitizes environment.
New full source build and independent FA ELF/numeric execution remain not_checked; qualification script existence is not four-case runtime acceptance.
FA-R4 optional operator build preflight/inherited PATH scope remains as originally noted
followup.conclusion: Original vacuous PASS and payload-output pollution defects addressed in read-only code scope. New immutable overlay is appropriate; old r2 asset must remain unchanged. Limited material review only; no NDF blanket PASS.
